subject: integration
name: Orivon Bitcoin
summary: The Bitcoin Crypto (BTC_0_1). It turns a public key into a segwit or taproot address, builds payments from coins at the person's own addresses, and prepares PSBT, message and swap-refund signing for the Account. It may read a funding transaction through the Bitcoin read code the person chose (judged on its own row) and attaches it only when its hash is the input's outpoint and its output matches the claim. It holds no key, opens no connection and runs no outside code. Level 4. Judged here by its publisher.
